newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei average ends down but above 18,000.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei average ends down but above 18,000.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key barometer closed lower on Thursday but kept its nose above the psychologically important 18,000 level.
Brokers said the market had not recovered completely from a tumble in the banking sector on Wednesday, although global blue-chips were sought.
The Nikkei 225 average ended 147.54 points or 0.81 percent lower at 18,038.43. Its March futures were in backwardation, a fall of 150 points taking them below the cash price to 18,030.
"More sales related to the fiscal year-end are expected and the outlook is far from optimistic," said Shinichi Ichikawa, strategist at Credit Lyonnais Securities.
